title: Roast cauliflower and spelt with rocket and feta

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Spelt, tinned chickpeas, stock, vegetables, feta and spices are all plain home-kitchen foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including pearled spelt and feta, is an everyday item at a mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, foil, knife and board, and a beginner can manage it.

works.reason: The spelt-to-stock ratio, the oven temperature and the 45 minutes in total should give cooked grains and tender cauliflower for four, though the veg may brown less sitting on the damp spelt.

honest_times.reason: The 15 minutes' prep is fair, but 45 minutes in the oven plus preheating makes this an hour-long dinner, which does not match the quick pace asked for.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the cumin and lemon, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: The rocket is only piled on at the end of a cauliflower-and-spelt traybake, so the hero is a garnish rather than the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear and neighbourly, in British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholegrain spelt, chickpeas, vegetables and feta make a filling, balanced family dinner.
